title: Lamb of God, We Fall Before Thee
description: Lamb of God, We Fall Before Thee in Tonic Solfa to ALL FOR JESUS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Joseph Hart wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 81.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ALL FOR JESUS; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Lamb of God, we fall be-fore Thee, Hum-bly trust-ing in Thy cross; That a-lone be all our glo-ry, All things else are on-ly dross.

lines: Lamb of God, we fall before Thee,
Humbly trusting in Thy cross;
That alone be all our glory,
All things else are only dross.
Thee we own a perfect Savior,
Only Source of all that’s good.
Every grace and every favor
Comes to us through Jesus’ blood.
Jesus gives us true repentance,
By His Spirit sent from heav’n;
Whispers this transporting sentence,
“Son, thy sins are all forgiv’n.”
Faith He grants us to believe it,
Grateful hearts His love to prize;
Want we wisdom? He must give it;
Hearing ears and seeing eyes.
Jesus gives us pure affections,
Wills to do what He requires,
Makes us follow His directions,
And what He commands, inspires.
All our prayers and all our praises,
Rightly offered in His name,—
He that dictates them is Jesus;
He that answers is the same.

licence: Public domain: Joseph Hart died in 1768.
credits: Words by Joseph Hart (1712–1768), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ALL FOR JESUS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
